title: Atlas accountability receipt
description: A durable, attributed record of one action and the inputs knowable when it was decided. Not a cryptographically signed attestation; it carries no signature or inclusion proof.

decision.description: DENY arrives with HTTP 403 and a full receipt. A refusal is accountable work and is metered.

evidence_ref.description: The evidence available at decision time, not what that source says now.

billed.description: False on a retry returning an existing receipt, and for all reads.
